about: Animated look (how-to card): opening of a Communication Clarity guide.

scenes.narration: Most misunderstandings are small gaps that grow when nobody checks.
A missed pickup. A report done the wrong way. A partner hurt by a short text.
Most misunderstandings aren't caused by bad people. They start as small gaps between what one person meant and what the other heard.
A ten second check, so we're meeting at the station, not the car park, can save an hour of confusion later.
This guide shows how to spot those gaps, confirm who does what, and repair a mix up quickly when one slips through.
Think of the last mix-up you had. Note in one line where the gap started: the words, the channel or an assumption.
